name: CPA Exam Prep: Ledgerwick
subtitle: CPA exam task-based sims
shortDescription: Practice the CPA exam sections with original multiple-choice questions and task-based simulations: journal entries, reconciliations, schedules and research...
longDescription:
CPA Exam Prep: Ledgerwick is an independent study aid for the Uniform CPA Examination: the three core sections (AUD, FAR, REG) and all three disciplines (BAR, ISC, TCP). It works offline, with no account.

BUILT FROM THE BLUEPRINTS. The AICPA 2026 blueprints list 671 representative tasks in 204 topics and content groups. Every one of those tasks has at least one of our original questions, and every topic has at least eight. The in-app Coverage screen shows the exact counts and your mastery, topic by topic.

2,205 ORIGINAL QUESTIONS AND 81 SIMULATIONS. Every option is explained or the working is shown, each item names a source you can open inside the app, and journal entries, reconciliations, schedules and research tasks are graded cell by cell.

ADAPTS TO YOU. A diagnostic, spaced review, and after every set a link to the lesson and practice for what you missed, the next best area with a one-line reason, and a short plan. Study in blueprint order or switch to Real-World builds: audit a client, close the books, prepare a return, report for a public body, review a service organisation, plan a family's tax year.

HONEST SCORES. Practice results are estimates. The real exam is scaled, and 75 is not 75 percent correct.

A study aid, not professional, tax or legal advice. Questions are original, are not real exam questions and have not been reviewed by a licensed CPA. Rules change: check the dated official sources in the app.

CPA and Uniform CPA Examination are used only to describe the exam. This independent app is not affiliated with, endorsed or approved by the AICPA, NASBA or any state board of accountancy.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
